title: Granular Real-Life Lifecycle Workflows for Pea Cultivation, Broth & Soup Hearth, Garage Joinery, Compost/Biochar & Poultry

workflows.workflow_name: Broadfork Loosen Subsoil, Haul Granular Compost/Biochar & Verify Crumb Tilth

nodes.name: Receive Bed Preparation Schedule from L5
Query L3 Ledger for Compost, Biochar & Raised Bed Frame
Soil Amendments Available?
Yield Stock Deficit Upward to L5 Governance
Haul Granular Topsoil, Thermophilic Compost & Biochar to Raised Bed
Broadfork Aerate 30 cm Root Horizon without Inverting Fungal Strata
Perform Hand Ribbon & Crumb Tilth Friability Check (pH 6.0-7.2)
Commit Amended Bed State to L3 Ledger

workflows.workflow_name: Erect Galvanized-Mesh A-Frame Climbing Pea Trellis

nodes.name: Trigger Trellis Installation
Verify Milled A-Frame Trellis Kit in L3 Stock
Trellis Kit Ready?
Yield Missing Trellis / Raised Bed Kit to L5
Carry 18.5 kg A-Frame Trellis to Backyard Bed, Align North-South & Stake Wind Anchors
Record Trellis Commissioning in L3

workflows.workflow_name: Coat Seeds in Rhizobium leguminosarum Slurry & Sow Peas + Mirepoix Understory

nodes.name: Initiate Seasonal Pea & Mirepoix Sowing
Lock Heirloom Pea Seed, Mirepoix Seed & Dechlorinated Water in L3
Seed & Inoculant Inputs Present?
Yield Seed Stock Miss Upward to L5
Coat Pisum sativum Seeds with Rhizobium leguminosarum bv. viceae Slurry in Shade
Dibber-Sow Inoculated Peas at 40 mm Depth Along Trellis & Broadcast Mirepoix Intercrop
Register Active Inoculated Crop Cohort in L3

workflows.workflow_name: Manual Soil/Leaf Inspection, Liquid Water Hauling by Can/Bucket & Hand Weeding

nodes.name: Daily Manual Garden Tend Trigger (No L2 Sensors Required)
Walk to Raised Bed & Inspect Soil Dampness at Knuckle Depth + Pea Tendril Turgor
Reserve 10,000 ml Potable/Cistern Water in L3
Water Available?
Yield Water Deficit Upward to L5
Acquire Watering Can or Bucket, Fill at Spigot/Cistern & Drench Root Crown + Hand-Weed
Settle Manual Irrigation & Weeding in L3

workflows.workflow_name: Closed-Loop L2FDR Probe Telemetry & 24V Drip Solenoid Irrigation

nodes.name: Ingest soil_probe_v1 Register Snapshot via L3 State Store
moisture_vwc_bp < 2800 && soil_temp_mk >= 275150?
Moisture Within Field Capacity or Frost Inhibit Active — No Actuation
Escrow 12,000 ml Cistern Water in L3
Cistern Head Sufficient?
Yield Cistern Water Deficit Upward to L5
Emit L2 Actuator Command to irrigation_valve_v1 via L3->L2 Membrane
Await valve_open == 0 && moisture_vwc_bp >= 3600 Telemetry Proof
Settle Automated Drip Cycle in L3 Ledger

workflows.workflow_name: Harvest Mature Pea Pods & Pull Companion Mirepoix Roots into Bucket/Basket

nodes.name: Crop Cohort Reaches Physiological Maturity
Hand-Pick Parchment-Dry Pea Pods from Trellis & Loosen Mirepoix Carrots/Onions
Haul Mirepoix Roots to Kitchen Larder & Pea Pods to Dry-Shelling Rack
Credit Harvested Pods & Mirepoix Roots to L3 Inventory

workflows.workflow_name: Thresh & Winnow Split Peas, Verify Moisture < 1400 bp & Cut-In Root Nodules

nodes.name: Begin Post-Harvest Pod Shelling & Bed Turnover
Shell Dry Pea Pods, Winnow Chaff & Reserve Top 15% Seed Stock for Next Season
Cure on Mesh Screens & Verify Seed Moisture < 1400 bp (14.0%) Against Mold Spoilage
Cut Pea Stems at Soil Line (Leaving Nitrogen-Rich Root Nodules Intact) & Haul Haulm to Compost/BSFL
Commit Dry Split Peas (< 1400 bp) & BSFL/Compost Biomass to L3

workflows.workflow_name: Verify & Stage Pea Soup / Bone Broth Culinary BOM (Yielding Upward to L5 on Stock Miss)

nodes.name: Receive Culinary Batch Intent via L5 Policy Gate
Query L3 Larder & Microgrid Exergy for Split Peas, Mirepoix, Broth, Eggs & Water
All BOM Inputs & Exergy Escrowed Locally?
Emit YIELD_UPWARD_L5 Over l4_l5.sock (L5 Evaluates R1_MESH -> L7_FALLBACK)
Rinse Split Peas, Inspect for Field Pebbles & Stage Mise-en-Place at Kitchen Counter
Culinary BOM Staged & Escrowed in L3

workflows.workflow_name: Roast Poultry Frames, 24-Hour Acid-Assisted Collagen Simmer & Spent-Bone Calcining

nodes.name: Start 24-Hour Collagen Bone Broth Extraction
Lock Poultry Bones, Mirepoix Trimmings, Potable Water & 6.48 MJ Exergy in L3
Bones & Water Escrowed?
Yield Broth Precursor Miss Upward to L5
Blanch & Skim Bones, Add Mirepoix Trimmings + 30 ml Cider Vinegar & Set Induction Simmer
Verify core_temp_mk >= 347150 && pasteurization_hold_s >= 120 (Up to 86400 s Full Hydrolysis)
Strain Golden Stock into Jars & Crush Friable Demineralized Bones into Calcium Grit
Credit 3,000 ml Bone Broth & 450 g Calcium Grit to L3

workflows.workflow_name: Sweat Mirepoix, Simmer Split-Pea & Bone-Broth Potage & Verify Bigelow Pasteurization

nodes.name: Begin Split-Pea Soup Batch Cooking
Brunoise Carrots, Onions, Celery & Garlic; Sweat Translucent at 1,200 W & Route Peelings to BSFL/Compost
Add Rinsed Split Peas, Bone Broth, Water & Bay Leaf; Simmer Until Starch Gelatinizes & Fold Poached Eggs
Verify Pasteurization Hold: core_temp_mk >= 347150 mK for pasteurization_hold_s >= 120 s
Certify 4,000 ml Pasteurized Pea Soup Batch in L3

workflows.workflow_name: Ladle Hot Pea Soup into 304-Stainless Tiffin Carriers & Distribute per L5 Policy

nodes.name: Initiate Tiffin Packaging & Commons Distribution
Lock 2,000 ml Pasteurized Pea Soup Surplus Above R0 Floor in L3
Pasteurized Soup Surplus Available?
Yield Soup Deficit Upward to L5
Hot-Fill Insulated 304-Stainless Tiffin Carrier (>= 338,150 mK) & Haul to Front Porch / R1 Hand-Off
Report Tiffin Hand-Off Proof to L3 BCC Ledger & L5 Reputation Account
Settle Tiffin Transfer & Returnable Vessel Deposit in L3

workflows.workflow_name: Dimension Cedar Planks, Cut Mortise-and-Tenon Corners & Haul Raised Bed Frame to Backyard

nodes.name: Start Raised Bed & Trellis Frame Joinery
Lock 8 Cedar Planks & 2.88 MJ Woodshop Electrical Exergy in L3
Cedar Stock Available?
Yield Timber Stock Miss Upward to L5
Plane Cedar Stock, Chisel Through-Mortises & Pin Corner Posts Within 550 cb Daytime Envelope
Transport 32 kg Cedar Raised Bed Frame to Backyard & Level on Compacted Footprint
Register Installed Raised Bed Frame & Trellis Kit in L3

workflows.workflow_name: Fabricate Insulated Thermophilic Compost Drum & Smokeless TLUD Kiln (Heavy-Mass Dolly/Wheelbarrow Haul)

nodes.name: Initiate Compost Drum & TLUD Retort Fabrication
Lock Drum Staves, Steel Retort Cylinder & Fasteners in L3
Fabrication Stock Escrowed?
Yield Fabrication Deficit Upward to L5
Assemble 74 kg Insulated Rotating Compost Drum & 68 kg Concentric Secondary-Air TLUD Kiln at Garage Workbench
Acquire Wheelbarrow or Hand Dolly & Roll Heavy Kiln (68 kg) + Compost Drum (74 kg) to Rear Yard Pad
Commission Compost Drum & TLUD Kiln in L3

workflows.workflow_name: Build Elevated Timber Poultry Coop & BSFL Bioconversion Feeder (115 kg Heavy-Mass Haul)

nodes.name: Initiate Backyard Poultry Coop Construction
Lock 12 Cedar/Fir Planks, Hardware Cloth & Biochar Litter Starter in L3
Coop Materials Escrowed?
Yield Coop Timber/Biochar Deficit Upward to L5
Frame 115 kg Predator-Proof Elevated Coop, Roost Bars, Nest Boxes & Self-Harvesting BSFL Larvae Ramp
Transport 115 kg Coop Module via Hand Dolly or Wheelbarrow to Backyard Run & Bed with Ammonia-Locking Biochar
Register Active Backyard Poultry Coop in L3

workflows.workflow_name: Mill & Oil-Finish Custom Mortised Joinery Commission for L5-Authorized Bill-Offset Surplus

nodes.name: Receive L5-Authorized Surplus Joinery Work Order Over l4_l5.sock
Lock Seasoned Timber Above R0/R1 Reserve Floor & 3.6 MJ Exergy in L3
Surplus Timber & Acoustic Window Valid?
Yield Timber Deficit or Quiet-Hours Deferral Upward to L5
Verify Kiln-Dried Lumber Moisture (800..1200 bp), Cut Precision Mortise-and-Tenon Joinery & Apply Linseed-Beeswax Finish
Roll 48 kg Finished Joinery Piece on Hand Dolly to Garage Driveway Apron for Pickup
Emit Fabrication Completion Proof Over l4_l5.sock (L5->L6->L7 Settles Bill-Offset Invoice)
Release L3 Material Escrow & Log Embodied Exergy
